ratings_why.fun: Over a 7 because the tribe's power comes from whatever this lobby and shop hold, so each game builds a different engine, and run-or-cash Worn is a real choice every turn.
ratings_why.distinct: Over a 7 because copying other tribes' text and tribe, plus trading your own units into the shop with Exchange, plays unlike any of today's tribes or a stat-stacking tribe.

verdict_why: Glamour-Veil Seamstress with Glamourer or Foundling makes an endless re-Guise loop, and the Lady/Moll copy rules need one clear line.

points.text: With Glamour-Veil Seamstress, two units can hand a Glamourer Guise back and forth forever; each re-Guise Unmasks and fires Knowe Usher again. Cap it, e.g. each unit can use a copied When played once a turn.
Unclear whether a Stock of the Lady under Wicker Moll counts as a 'copy of her', and whether text Moll grants counts as 'printed'. Write which so two Ladies resolve one way.
Fetch of the Front Rank could keep the copied text as a Guise if it survives the fight, tying it into Worn and Unmask.
Keeper of the Lost Hour only adds a number; letting it also stop Grandfer Acorn from Unmasking one chosen unit would make Long Con and Applause share a board.
Clerk of Exchanges could Exchange a unit you own for one in your next opponent's last board, which fits 'whatever they are traded for'.

standouts.why: Turns every Guise card into a When played repeater, including other tribes' best When played units.
Mirror-backwards copying turns position text into a puzzle, and Pass to the leftmost is a use nobody planned.
Guises counting toward triples links copy, Exchange buy-backs and Discover into one chain.

weakest.why: Pure multiplier on a counter; no decision of its own.
A free Stock is useful glue but plays the same every time.
Reads one counter and pays stats; the obvious payoff in a tribe full of clever ones.

flags.note: Endless re-Guise loop with Glamourer or Foundling; with Knowe Usher it stacks stats without end.
Glamourer plus Exchange buy-backs may make goldens of carries every turn.
Golden Moll copying the Lady may run away.
Copies of the Lady via Moll Stocks are not ruled on.
